feeds.title: Mindful Infusions Blog
feeds.description: Interested in ketamine therapy and how it can help you? Visit our blog to learn more about ketamine treatment and the conditions it can help treat.Given in low doses, ketamine infusions have been shown to ease the symptoms of depression, anxiety, PTSD, OCD, and more. While useful for combatting mental health disorders, ketamine also helps reset and restore nerve connections in the body, making it a prime candidate as an alternative treatment for various pain conditions such as CRPS and fibromyalgia for example...
